mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, create_time FROM aigc_conversation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id) AS message_count FROM aigc_conversation c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.title, c.create_time, COALESCE(u.username, m.username, c.user_id) AS username, COALESCE(m.message_count, 0) AS message_count, COALESCE(m.token_used, 0) AS token_used, m.last_conversation_time FROM aigc_conversation c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(username) AS username, COUNT(*) AS message_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS token_used, MAX(create_time) AS last_conversation_time FROM aigc_message GROUP BY conversation_id ) m ON m.conversation_id = c.id

where.if: AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: ORDER BY COALESCE(m.last_conversation_time, c.create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aigc_conversation c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(username) AS username FROM aigc_message GROUP BY conversation_id ) m ON m.conversation_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aigc_conversation (id, user_id, title, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{createTime})
